To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the pattern of sympathetic nerve activity influences the rapidity of renal vasoconstric-tion, the magnitude and selectivity of renal vascular and tubuloglomerular responses, and the renal functional responses.
the pattern of sympathetic activation significantly influences the renal functional responses.
the pattern of activation of renal sympathetic nerve (RSN) activity (i.e., the pattern of the RSN action potential train) significantly influences the renal vascular and excretory function.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how renal nerves modulate renal function.
the neural regulation of kidney function.
the neural control of renal hemodynamic and tubular functions and the functional significance of the patterns of renal sympathetic nerve firing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

renal nerve stimulation (activity or discharge) patterns, which resemble those observed during in vivo recordings, produce more rapid and greater renal vascular and tubuloglomerular responses than conventional stimulus patterns.
the functional significance of renal sympathetic nerve discharge patterns (activity) is the rapidity and magnitude of the renal hemodynamic and tubular responses.

the functional significance of the renal sympathetic nerve activity pattern depends on the pattern of activation of individual renal sympathetic nerve fibers, the pattern of activation and the frequency of the renal sympathetic nerves, and the pattern of activation during intermittent stimulation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
renal sympathetic nerve stimulation patterns are important in determining the magnitude and selectivity of renal responses.
, in general, the pattern of renal nerve stimulation is important in determining the functional responses to renal nerve stimulation.

the pattern of sympathetic nerve activation (stimulation) significantly influences renal vascular resistance and tubular function, and these effects can be explained by the pattern of renal nerve activation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
renal sympathetic nerve activity patterns can have functional significance.
the pattern of activation of the renal sympathetic nerves influences the rapidity and selectivity of renal vascular and tubuloglomerular responses.
the pattern of nerve activity (i.e., the number, frequency, and duration of action potentials) is a critical determinant of the renal functional responses.
